sections.title: Added
items: Show a merged 30-day token usage history card (today, 30-day total, daily average, 30-day bar chart, and top models) across all connected computers in the desktop and web Usage modal and Settings Usage section, with Chinese 万 / 亿 token unit hints in Chinese locales across both the app and iOS widgets.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Merge subscription quota accounts and 30-day daily usage history across all connected computers when iOS widgets use the default "Automatic" computer selection, while preserving single-computer filtering when a specific computer is chosen.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Sync host daily token history into iOS usage widgets without requiring open phone sessions, and label missing cost data explicitly instead of showing $0.00.
Refresh iOS usage widgets when daily token history updates even if subscription quota percentages are unchanged.
Allow edited agent launch drafts to retry after workspace startup failures.
Keep remote relay connections responsive when host filesystem inspection blocks on slow or protected directories.
Stream Antigravity thinking updates during active turns without replaying completed reasoning.
Filter unavailable host providers and uninstalled CLI commands out of model and profile pickers, and skip unsupported legacy favorites during profile migration.
Resolve dictation and voice STT language dynamically and prevent premature 3-second audio chunk cutoffs on StepFun ASR.
Require the configured daemon password on legacy relay admission handshakes.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Translate interactive questions, option descriptions and plan confirmations while preserving original submitted answers.
Keep Markdown structure, prioritize current questions and allow retry with the original text available.
Complete the plugin migration reference and Chinese release notes for the translation update.
Keep copy-button feedback from leaving a stuck hover highlight; include main-branch connection recovery updates.

notes: This iOS/TestFlight update requires the updated conversation-translation plugin on the connected host for interactive card translations.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Translate interactive question labels, options and plan confirmations while preserving original submitted answers.
Preserve Markdown structure and prioritize current questions. Failed translations keep the original text and support retry.
Verify translated question navigation, option links, text selection and answer retries in the browser regression suite.

notes: This iOS/TestFlight update requires the updated conversation-translation plugin on the connected host for interactive card translations.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Start packaged desktop daemons from a stable, private data directory so quota plugins load when the app inherits an inaccessible working directory. Keep the same behavior after daemon restarts.
Recover inaccessible Linux desktop launch directories while preserving Node CLI working directories.
Complete the Chinese documentation for interactive card translation.

sections.title: Improved
items: Refine the website's page hierarchy, cards and footer, and place Simplified and Traditional Chinese directly below English in the language menu.

notes: Includes the interactive question and plan confirmation translations introduced in 1.5.2. Update both the client and the connected host to use them.

sections.title: 新增
items: 桌面端与网页端「用量」弹窗及设置页新增跨全部已连接电脑合并的近 30 天历史 token 用量卡片（今日、30 天总计、日均、30 天柱状趋势与常用模型占比），并在中文界面与 iOS 小组件中为百万/十亿级 token 补充 （万 / 亿） 单位提示。

sections.title: 修复
items: iOS 订阅余量与每日用量小组件在默认的「自动」模式下自动合并所有已连接电脑的账号余量与近 30 天历史 token 用量（不再只锁定单台电脑），手动指定单台电脑时仍仅展示该电脑的数据。

sections.title: 修复
items: iOS 用量小组件直接接入主机历史日用量账本，无需在手机端先打开会话即可展示今日与近 30 天总 token，并将未上报的费用明确标记为“暂无费用数据”而不再误显 $0.00。
修复订阅额度百分比不变时，新增历史 token 用量不触发小组件刷新的问题。
工作区启动失败后修改草稿并重试时，使用最新编辑的配置重新创建会话。
主机目录探测在受保护或阻塞目录上卡住时通过隔离工作线程执行，保持远程中继连接响应。
Antigravity 执行期间实时展示思考过程，且不重复回放已完成轮次的推理内容。
模型与预设选择器过滤当前主机未安装或不可用的服务，迁移旧版收藏时自动跳过目标主机不支持的模型。
动态解析听写与实时语音的识别语言配置，并修复阶跃语音识别被 3 秒分片提前截断的问题。
移除旧版中继握手免密兼容分支，统一要求已配置的访问密码。

sections.title: 修复
items: 翻译交互题目、选项说明和计划确认内容，同时保留原始答案提交值。
保留 Markdown 结构，优先翻译当前提问；失败时保留原文并支持重试。
补齐翻译更新的插件迁移参考文档和中文更新日志。
修复复制反馈结束后按钮高亮残留，并包含主分支的网络恢复与消息重发改进。

notes: 本次为 iOS/TestFlight 更新，交互卡片翻译还需要连接主机上的新版会话翻译插件。

sections.title: 修复
items: 翻译交互题目的标签、问题、选项和计划确认内容，同时保留原始答案提交值。
保留 Markdown 结构并优先翻译当前提问；失败时保留原文并支持重试。
通过浏览器回归用例验证翻译后的题目导航、选项链接、文本选择和答案重试。

notes: 本次为 iOS/TestFlight 更新，交互卡片翻译还需要连接主机上的新版会话翻译插件。

sections.title: 修复
items: 从稳定且私有的数据目录启动桌面 daemon，让应用继承不可访问的工作目录时仍能加载额度插件，重启 daemon 后保持相同行为。
恢复 Linux 桌面启动时不可访问的工作目录，同时保留 Node CLI 的工作目录。
补齐交互卡片翻译的中文文档。

sections.title: 改进
items: 优化官网页面层级、卡片和页脚，将简体中文和繁体中文紧接英语排列。

notes: 包含 1.5.2 引入的交互题目与计划确认翻译，需要同时更新客户端和连接的主机。
